verdict.rationale: Fathom's docs show meeting capture with a choice of bot or bot-free (beta) modes, unlimited recordings and transcriptions, a custom meeting bot, and an API endpoint for downloading recordings. That covers the capture and recording-control parts of the story. However, nothing in the pack names Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams, and nothing corroborates reliability. Missing for 10: explicit Zoom/Google Meet/Microsoft Teams platform support, evidence of capture reliability, per-meeting recording controls beyond bot vs. bot-free, and independent hands-on corroboration.
